source_coverage: Partial reconstruction from accessible conversation excerpts, memory, historical MRIE workstream artifacts and GitHub source tree. No complete raw ChatGPT transcript export. Repo audited on 2026-10-16; CI failure identified in relationships schema mismatch.
bootstrap_policy: Each launched NEW conversation creates its own issue then unique branch. Dormant sparks do NOT have pre-created issues or branches. Project instructions should direct ChatGPT to read AGENTS.md and this catalog.

global_rules.ttd: Time to Die; never present expired observations/calculations as live
global_rules.history: 200+ completed daily sessions for eligible public tickers; private entities never get synthetic OHLCV
global_rules.cross_domain_action: Create linked GitHub dependency issue and provide ready-to-paste handoff prompt
global_rules.non_merge: Work on branch, PR review, never auto-merge
global_rules.tests_policy: Unit tests follow engine/ticker domain; B01 owns integration tests, validator and CI workflow. Contract changes follow B00 and require handoffs.
global_rules.collision_policy: Exclusive writes are enforced by checking open issue scopes AND active PR changed files; a spark launch while another worker owns the same file must narrow its target or hand off.
global_rules.evidence_temporality: Separate fact effective date, observation date, first available date, ingest date, period end, and expiration by data class.
global_rules.merge_readiness: Orchestration PR #2 must be available on main before new sparks read AGENTS.md from main. Do not merge without authorization.
global_rules.data_plane: Runtime market observations require authenticated entitled provider + persistent worker. ChatGPT and GitHub do not themselves provide a polling runtime.
global_rules.dependency_semantics: Catalog dependencies flag contracts and necessary coordination, not automatic blockers for read-only research; release gates define when outputs may be described as operational.
global_rules.bootstrap_if_unmerged: Until PR #2 is merged, new worker may READ AGENTS.md and orchestration/sparks.json from work/1-conversation-sparks-orchestration, but MUST create a distinct new issue and branch from current main. After merging PR #2, main becomes the authoritative instruction source.
global_rules.ci_repair_first: B05 can preserve six additional SFTBY relationship top-level fields losslessly in B05-owned research/graph sidecar while retaining permitted canonical relationship properties, without waiting for B00 optional schema evolution. B01 independently verifies strict validation.
global_rules.full_instructions_delivery: When user requests Project Instructions or changes, return their COMPLETE current text in ONE copyable block. Do not split or provide only diffs.
global_rules.versioning_policy: Core SemVer, catalog SemVer, schema major, data append-only revisions and engine algorithm/config versions are distinct. New core releases require gates and explicit authorization.
global_rules.worker_resolution: Every worker posts the basket.worker_resolution@1 payload with acceptance IDs, CI/test outcomes and URLs, changed paths, blockers, handoffs, unknowns and next action. B00 independently validates it against fetched GitHub evidence; see orchestration/WORKER_PROTOCOL.md.
global_rules.readiness: A worker can be component verified without being integrated. A merged PR still needs main CI verification; no auto merge.
global_rules.reusable_workers: Use B00 planner queue and reusable capability profiles; one new worker issue/branch per new conversation, even when role/recipe is reused. A worker can compose roles but must not cross domain write paths.
global_rules.queue_honesty: Queue ordering is a heuristic, not a prediction or completion claim; GitHub is authoritative for issue/PR state and no active-worker count may be inferred from draft PRs alone.
